## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/_deprecations.py:94-112` schedules three public removals: the Python-library `rebar.transition(force_close=...)` keyword, boolean `rebar.transition(force=True)`, and explicit hosted-OpenAI `openai-chat:` model selection. Closed migration `blusterous-earthly-kitten` established the temporary warning mappings; this ticket is the scheduled retirement, not a duplicate of that migration. The CLI already rejects retired close spellings in `src/rebar/_commands/transition.py`. The MCP transition schema never exposed `force_close`.

## End State

The Python library accepts only a reason-bearing string `force="<reason>"`. `force_close` or boolean `force=True` fail at the library boundary with `force="<reason>"` named as the replacement. Hosted model selection accepts `openai-responses:<model>`. Both live hosted-resolution paths reject explicit `openai-chat:`. Custom OpenAI-compatible `base_url` selection retains its Chat Completions dialect.

## Implementation Plan

1. Retire the two library mappings in `_lib_writes` and `_deprecations`. Do not add an environment or configuration tombstone: these are callable inputs, so validation belongs at the Python boundary.
2. Regenerate the API snapshot plus MCP-library parity manifest after the library signature changes.
3. Retire hosted explicit `openai-chat:` in both resolver clusters: `_resolve_target` plus `_pai_model`/`_openai_wire_prefix`. Preserve the custom-endpoint branch. Migrate the hosted `gpt-5.4*` provider inventory to `openai-responses:`.
4. Update maintained documentation plus generated references. Preserve historical `force_close_reason` durable state.
5. Add focused boundary, resolver, provider, manifest, and documentation-generation regression coverage.

## File Impact

- `src/rebar/_deprecations.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_writes.py` — retired library inputs
- `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json`, `scripts/gen_api_surface.py` — generated public API signature snapshot
- `tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json`, `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py` — retired library-only parity divergence
- `src/rebar/llm/runner.py`, `src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py`, `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py`, `src/rebar/llm/config.py`, `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml` — both hosted model-resolution paths plus deployed model inventory
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py` plus focused transition/provider tests — hosted, custom-endpoint, and input-boundary behavior
- maintained API/provider docs, generated references, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/release-notes.md` — replacement guidance

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `rebar.transition(force_close="legacy")` is rejected at the Python-library boundary. Its error names `force="<explicit reason>"`.
- [ ] `rebar.transition(force=True)` is rejected at the Python-library boundary. Its error names `force="<explicit reason>"`.
- [ ] `rebar.transition(force="approved reason")` remains accepted.
- [ ] `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json` is regenerated through `scripts/gen_api_surface.py`. Its `transition` signature has no `force_close` row.
- [ ] `tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json` removes the retired `force_close` divergence plus its `library_params` entry. `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py` passes.
- [ ] The CLI retains its existing retired-input rejection. This ticket adds no CLI force-close removal.
- [ ] The MCP transition schema remains free of `force_close`. This ticket adds no MCP force-close removal.
- [ ] Explicit hosted `openai-chat:gpt-5.4` is rejected through `_resolve_target`. Its error names `openai-responses:gpt-5.4`.
- [ ] Explicit hosted `openai-chat:gpt-5.4` is rejected through `_pai_model`. Its error names `openai-responses:gpt-5.4`.
- [ ] Explicit hosted `openai-responses:gpt-5.4` succeeds.
- [ ] Each hosted `gpt-5.4*` entry in `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml` uses `openai-responses:`.
- [ ] A custom OpenAI-compatible `base_url` retains Chat Completions routing.
- [ ] Maintained documentation names the canonical replacements. Historical durable `force_close_reason` state remains intact.
- [ ] Focused boundary, resolver, provider, generated-reference, lint, and typecheck checks pass.
